metadata.name: Civilization Technology Graph
metadata.description: Structured technology taxonomy: domains, subdomains, principles, processes, components, systems, industries, cemetery, candidates. Three relationship classes: structural, functional, historical.

constraint_migration.note: Constraints derived from node type, domain, and graph position. These are priors, not calibrations — they should be refined as real data accumulates.

ingestion.note: Real constraint values from actual patent/paper text, not Phase 2 type/domain/edge priors.

cycle_6_patch.note: One-line fixes to the canonical graph. N3 closes the metadata drift the auditor flagged in commit 53320bc. F-022 closes Phase 3 Step 5 (cemetery fields) by promoting metadata.lesson/why_it_failed to top-level fields the GraphModel adapter actually reads.
